body.name: Feasible optimally weighted residual-cumulant GMM
body.construction: For data drawn under \(P_m\), let \(\widetilde\theta_{n,m}\) be the lexicographically least member of \(\arg\min_{\vartheta\in\Theta}\|g_{n,m}(\vartheta)\|^2\), and construct \(\widehat S_{n,m}\) from plug-in centered influence vectors at \(\widetilde\theta_{n,m}\). Use the measurable weight \(\widehat S_{n,m}^{-1}\) when \(\widehat S_{n,m}\) is invertible and \(I_3\) otherwise, and set \(\widehat\theta_{n,m}\) to the lexicographically least minimizer of the resulting weighted criterion over \(\Theta\).
